initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17706 was found. The PATCH section was introduced by b1842341d2 with the typo "handling etc applies as specified". The later typo sweep 7bf7397f4a changed the verb to "apply", and subsequent RESTful API/page cleanup retained that corrected verb while updating surrounding wording from operation to interaction.
additional_context: source/http.html is in build scope: source/navigation.xml lists the http page as the REST (HTTP) implementation page, and publish.ini maps http.html to the http output page. Current source/http.html line 959 already says "all the version and error handling etc. apply as specified". Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-17706 and the exact sentence found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already carries the substantive correction requested by FHIR-17706; the remaining punctuation difference from the Jira example around "etc." does not change implementer understanding and does not meet the source-edit threshold for this reconciliation.
